crossRefs.note: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

translations.web: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
translations.bsb: When you walk, your steps will not be impeded; when you run, you will not stumble.
translations.kjv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
translations.asv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
